# ADR-000 — Template

**Status:** Template — copy, do not edit in place.

## Context

What forces are in play. What the constraint is, who it binds, and what makes the
decision hard to reverse. Facts, not preferences: if the reason is "the bundler will
not guarantee module identity across subpath entries", say that, because in two years
that sentence is the only thing that explains the shape of the code.

## Decision

What we are doing, in the present tense, in one or two sentences.

### Alternatives considered

| Option | Why not |
| --- | --- |
| The obvious one | What it would have cost |

### Risk accepted

Include this section whenever the decision carries security, reliability or
operational risk. Omit it only when there genuinely is none, and say so.

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | |

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and what a future maintainer has to keep
doing because of this. Include the things that will read as bugs to someone who does
not know about this decision.
